issue.title: parse_date returns March 1st for 2024-02-30 instead of raising
issue.body:
### Description
After upgrading to v2.3, `parse_date("2024-02-30")` returns `2024-03-01` instead of raising `ValueError`. In v2.2 it raised as expected.

### Steps to reproduce
```python
from datekit import parse_date
print(parse_date("2024-02-30"))
```

### Expected
`ValueError: day is out of range for month`

### Actual
`2024-03-01`

### Environment
- datekit 2.3.0
- Python 3.12
- Ubuntu 22.04
